terms.signature: An authorization signature; its count is not the number of operations or cards.
terms.operation: One protocol operation; a custom_json payload can describe many items.
terms.item: An application-level card or other entry inside one operation.

limits.unit: custom operations per impacted account per block, including pending admission
limits.scope: Pinned stock Hive implementation; not a universal transaction item limit or an assertion about every node's policy.
Pinned evaluator checks; item capacity depends on the encoded payload.

limits.formula: current maximum block size minus 256 bytes
limits.scope: Do not substitute a universal 64 KiB constant.
A wallet or application may choose a smaller batch. A four-operation policy does not imply four cards per transaction.
No universal maximum is established. Operation schema, application validation and byte budgets matter. A successful sample is a lower bound, not a maximum.

workflow: hive_account_history with explicit account and optional custom_json_id
scope: Read evidence only. This resource does not change wallet, signer, or application batching policies.
